kb_avatar_too_large.zh-CN: 图标大小不能超过 1 MiB。
kb_avatar_too_large.en-US: The icon must not exceed 1 MiB.

kb_avatar_invalid.zh-CN: 请选择有效的 PNG、JPG/JPEG 或 WebP 图标。
kb_avatar_invalid.en-US: Choose a valid PNG, JPG/JPEG or WebP icon.

kb_avatar_unavailable.zh-CN: 图标存储服务暂不可用，请稍后重试。
kb_avatar_unavailable.en-US: Icon storage is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

kb_form_invalid.zh-CN: 知识库表单无效或图标大小超过 1 MiB。
kb_form_invalid.en-US: The knowledge base form is invalid or the icon exceeds 1 MiB.

kb_write_forbidden.en-US: You only have read access to this knowledge base.

document_revision_conflict.zh-CN: 文档已更新，请刷新后重试。
document_revision_conflict.en-US: The document has changed. Refresh and try again.

request_failed.en-US: The operation failed. Please try again later.

invalid_request.zh-CN: 请求参数无效，请检查填写内容。
invalid_request.en-US: The request is invalid. Please check the input.

invalid_json.zh-CN: 请求格式无效，请提交一个有效的 JSON 对象。
invalid_json.en-US: The request must contain one valid JSON object.

not_found.zh-CN: 资源不存在或无权访问。
not_found.en-US: The resource does not exist or you do not have access.

revision_conflict.zh-CN: 配置已更新，请刷新后重试。
revision_conflict.en-US: The configuration has changed. Refresh and try again.

name_conflict.zh-CN: 名称或关联已存在，请使用其他名称。
name_conflict.en-US: The name or association already exists. Please use a different name.

invalid_reference.zh-CN: 关联对象无效或已删除，请重新选择。
invalid_reference.en-US: A referenced resource is invalid or has been deleted. Please select it again.

resource_error.zh-CN: 资源操作失败，请稍后重试。
resource_error.en-US: The resource operation failed. Please try again later.

embedding_model_unavailable.zh-CN: 向量模型不存在、未启用或未完成探测，请先配置并启用向量模型。
embedding_model_unavailable.en-US: The embedding model is missing, disabled, or not probed. Configure and enable an embedding model first.

embedding_dimension_invalid.zh-CN: 向量模型缺少可用维度，请先测试并保存模型。
embedding_dimension_invalid.en-US: The embedding model has no usable dimension. Test and save the model first.

embedding_not_configured.zh-CN: 知识库未配置可用的向量模型。
embedding_not_configured.en-US: The knowledge base does not have a usable embedding model.

embedding_model_switch_required.zh-CN: 更新向量模型请使用专用的模型切换接口。
embedding_model_switch_required.en-US: Use the dedicated model switch endpoint to change the embedding model.

embedding_model_unchanged.zh-CN: 目标向量模型与当前模型相同。
embedding_model_unchanged.en-US: The target embedding model is the same as the current model.

invalid_fusion_config.zh-CN: 融合配置无效，请检查融合类型、RRF 常数和通道权重。
invalid_fusion_config.en-US: The fusion configuration is invalid. Check the fusion type, RRF constant, and channel weights.

vector_unavailable.zh-CN: 向量检索暂不可用，请检查向量模型配置或改用全文检索。
vector_unavailable.en-US: Vector retrieval is unavailable. Check the embedding model configuration or use lexical search.

vector_dimension_mismatch.zh-CN: 向量维度与模型配置不一致，请重新测试并保存模型配置。
vector_dimension_mismatch.en-US: The vector dimension does not match the model configuration. Test and save the model configuration again.

internal_error.zh-CN: 服务内部错误，请稍后重试。
internal_error.en-US: An internal server error occurred. Please try again later.

precondition_required.zh-CN: 缺少配置版本，请刷新后重试。
precondition_required.en-US: The configuration version is missing. Refresh and try again.

reference_conflict.zh-CN: 资源仍被引用，请先移除关联。
reference_conflict.en-US: The resource is still in use. Remove its references first.

package_resource_read_only.zh-CN: 资源由发布包管理，无法直接修改。
package_resource_read_only.en-US: This resource is managed by a release package and cannot be edited directly.

unauthorized.en-US: Please sign in and try again.

invalid_token.zh-CN: 登录状态无效或已过期，请重新登录。
invalid_token.en-US: Your sign-in has expired or is invalid. Please sign in again.

forbidden.zh-CN: 权限不足，请联系管理员。
forbidden.en-US: You do not have permission. Please contact your administrator.

permission_denied.zh-CN: 当前授权不允许此操作，请检查访问权限。
permission_denied.en-US: Your authorization does not allow this operation. Please check your access.

service_unavailable.zh-CN: 服务暂不可用，请稍后重试。
service_unavailable.en-US: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

rate_limited.zh-CN: 请求过于频繁，请稍后重试。
rate_limited.en-US: Too many requests. Please try again later.

insufficient_credits.zh-CN: 当期可用积分不足，请联系管理员调整额度。
insufficient_credits.en-US: There are not enough credits in the current period. Please contact your administrator.

authorization_required.zh-CN: 所选凭证需要认证，请添加凭证或重新授权。
authorization_required.en-US: The selected credential needs authentication. Add a credential or authorize it again.

credential_selection_required.zh-CN: 请选择此连接使用的凭证。
credential_selection_required.en-US: Please select a credential for this connection.

credential_name_invalid.zh-CN: 凭证名称须为 1—128 个字符。
credential_name_invalid.en-US: The credential name must contain 1–128 characters.

credential_headers_invalid.zh-CN: 认证请求头无效，请检查名称、数量和保留字段。
credential_headers_invalid.en-US: The authentication headers are invalid. Check their names, count, and reserved fields.

credential_input_required.zh-CN: 请提供凭证名称和所需的认证请求头。
credential_input_required.en-US: Please provide the credential name and required authentication headers.

credential_management_denied.zh-CN: 当前用户无权管理此凭证。
credential_management_denied.en-US: You do not have permission to manage this credential.

credential_binding_invalid.zh-CN: 凭证绑定无效，请先选择连接，再选择对应凭证。
credential_binding_invalid.en-US: The credential binding is invalid. Select a connection and then its credential.

credential_binding_unsupported.zh-CN: 此连接不使用独立凭证绑定。
credential_binding_unsupported.en-US: This connection does not use independent credential bindings.

oauth_not_supported.zh-CN: 此连接不支持 OAuth 授权，请检查认证方式。
oauth_not_supported.en-US: This connection does not support OAuth. Please check its authentication method.

oauth_reauthorization_required.zh-CN: 请通过重新授权流程更新 OAuth 凭证。
oauth_reauthorization_required.en-US: Please authorize again to update this OAuth credential.

oauth_central_credential_exists.zh-CN: 已存在集中凭证，请选择该凭证重新授权。
oauth_central_credential_exists.en-US: A shared credential already exists. Select it to authorize again.

oauth_authorization_url_invalid.zh-CN: OAuth 授权地址无效，请检查服务配置。
oauth_authorization_url_invalid.en-US: The OAuth authorization URL is invalid. Please check the service configuration.

oauth_authorization_invalid.zh-CN: 授权请求无效、已过期或已使用，请重新发起授权。
oauth_authorization_invalid.en-US: The authorization request is invalid, expired, or already used. Please start again.

oauth_authorization_cancelled.zh-CN: 授权已取消，请重新发起授权。
oauth_authorization_cancelled.en-US: Authorization was cancelled. Please start again.

oauth_authorization_code_missing.zh-CN: 授权服务未返回授权码，请重新发起授权。
oauth_authorization_code_missing.en-US: The authorization service did not return a code. Please start again.

oauth_authorization_failed.zh-CN: 授权失败，请重新发起授权。

oauth_authorization_expired.zh-CN: 授权请求已过期，请重新发起授权。
oauth_authorization_expired.en-US: The authorization request has expired. Please start again.

oauth_discovery_failed.zh-CN: OAuth 自动发现失败，请检查服务配置或改用手动配置。
oauth_discovery_failed.en-US: OAuth discovery failed. Check the service configuration or configure OAuth manually.

oauth_metadata_not_found.zh-CN: 未找到 OAuth 元数据，请检查服务地址或改用手动配置。
oauth_metadata_not_found.en-US: OAuth metadata was not found. Check the service URL or configure OAuth manually.

oauth_metadata_invalid.zh-CN: OAuth 元数据无效，请检查授权服务配置。
oauth_metadata_invalid.en-US: The OAuth metadata is invalid. Please check the authorization service configuration.

oauth_metadata_rejected.zh-CN: 服务拒绝读取 OAuth 元数据，请检查服务访问权限。
oauth_metadata_rejected.en-US: The service rejected the OAuth metadata request. Please check access permissions.

oauth_pkce_unsupported.zh-CN: 授权服务不支持 PKCE S256，无法安全完成授权。
oauth_pkce_unsupported.en-US: The authorization service does not support PKCE S256, which is required to authorize securely.

oauth_auth_method_unsupported.zh-CN: 授权服务的客户端认证方式不受支持，请检查 OAuth 配置。
oauth_auth_method_unsupported.en-US: The authorization service uses an unsupported client authentication method. Please check the OAuth configuration.

oauth_registration_unsupported.zh-CN: 该服务不支持自动注册，请改用手动配置并填写 Client ID。
oauth_registration_unsupported.en-US: This service does not support automatic registration. Configure OAuth manually and enter a Client ID.

oauth_registration_failed.zh-CN: OAuth 客户端注册失败，请检查注册端点或手动填写 Client ID。
oauth_registration_failed.en-US: OAuth client registration failed. Check the registration endpoint or enter a Client ID manually.

oauth_registration_rejected.zh-CN: 授权服务拒绝客户端注册，请检查注册配置或手动填写 Client ID。
oauth_registration_rejected.en-US: The authorization service rejected client registration. Check the registration settings or enter a Client ID manually.

oauth_registration_response_invalid.zh-CN: 客户端注册响应无效，请检查注册服务或手动填写 Client ID。
oauth_registration_response_invalid.en-US: The client registration response is invalid. Check the registration service or enter a Client ID manually.

oauth_exchange_failed.zh-CN: OAuth Token 交换失败，请重新发起授权；若仍失败，请检查 Client ID、密钥和回调地址。
oauth_exchange_failed.en-US: The OAuth token exchange failed. Authorize again; if it still fails, check the Client ID, secret, and callback URL.

oauth_token_rejected.zh-CN: 授权服务拒绝换取 Token，请检查 Client ID、密钥和回调地址。
oauth_token_rejected.en-US: The authorization service rejected the token request. Check the Client ID, secret, and callback URL.

oauth_token_response_invalid.zh-CN: 授权服务返回的 Token 响应无效，请检查服务配置。
oauth_token_response_invalid.en-US: The authorization service returned an invalid token response. Please check the service configuration.

oauth_credentials_expired.zh-CN: OAuth 凭证已失效，请重新授权。
oauth_credentials_expired.en-US: The OAuth credential has expired or been revoked. Please authorize again.

oauth_refresh_failed.zh-CN: OAuth 凭证刷新暂时失败，请稍后重试。
oauth_refresh_failed.en-US: The OAuth credential could not be refreshed. Please try again later.

oauth_succeeded.zh-CN: 授权成功，已测试连接并更新工具列表，请返回 MonkeyAI。
oauth_succeeded.en-US: Authorization succeeded. The connection was tested and the tools updated. Please return to MonkeyAI.

oauth_succeeded_test_failed.zh-CN: 授权成功，但连接测试失败，请返回 MonkeyAI 查看凭证状态并重试连接测试。
oauth_succeeded_test_failed.en-US: Authorization succeeded, but the connection test failed. Return to MonkeyAI to check the credential and retry the test.

mcp_timeout.zh-CN: 连接服务超时，请检查服务地址和网络后重试。
mcp_timeout.en-US: The connection timed out. Check the service URL and network, then try again.

mcp_dns_failed.zh-CN: 无法解析服务域名，请检查服务地址和 DNS 配置。
mcp_dns_failed.en-US: The service hostname could not be resolved. Check the service URL and DNS settings.

mcp_tls_failed.zh-CN: 服务的 TLS 证书校验失败，请检查证书、域名和有效期。
mcp_tls_failed.en-US: The service TLS certificate could not be verified. Check its certificate, hostname, and validity.

mcp_address_denied.zh-CN: 服务地址不在允许访问的范围内，请联系管理员检查网络访问配置。
mcp_address_denied.en-US: The service address is outside the allowed network range. Ask your administrator to check network access settings.

mcp_redirect_denied.zh-CN: 服务返回了重定向，请配置最终服务地址。
mcp_redirect_denied.en-US: The service returned a redirect. Please configure the final service URL.

mcp_connect_failed.zh-CN: 无法连接服务，请检查地址、端口、网络及代理配置。
mcp_connect_failed.en-US: The service could not be reached. Check its URL, port, network, and proxy settings.

mcp_upstream_unauthorized.zh-CN: 服务认证失败，请更新认证请求头或重新授权。
mcp_upstream_unauthorized.en-US: Service authentication failed. Update the authentication headers or authorize again.

mcp_upstream_forbidden.zh-CN: 服务拒绝访问，请检查所选凭证的权限。
mcp_upstream_forbidden.en-US: The service denied access. Check the selected credential's permissions.

mcp_upstream_not_found.zh-CN: 服务端点不存在，请检查 MCP 服务地址和路径。
mcp_upstream_not_found.en-US: The service endpoint was not found. Check the MCP service URL and path.

mcp_upstream_rate_limited.zh-CN: 服务请求过于频繁，请稍后重试。
mcp_upstream_rate_limited.en-US: The service is rate limiting requests. Please try again later.

mcp_upstream_unavailable.zh-CN: 上游服务暂不可用，请稍后重试。
mcp_upstream_unavailable.en-US: The upstream service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

mcp_protocol_invalid.zh-CN: 服务返回的 MCP 响应无效，请检查服务协议和端点配置。
mcp_protocol_invalid.en-US: The service returned an invalid MCP response. Check its protocol and endpoint configuration.

mcp_protocol_unsupported.zh-CN: 服务的 MCP 协议版本不受支持，请升级服务或检查地址。
mcp_protocol_unsupported.en-US: The service MCP protocol version is not supported. Upgrade the service or check its URL.

mcp_tools_invalid.zh-CN: 服务返回的工具列表无效或超限，请检查 MCP 服务。
mcp_tools_invalid.en-US: The service returned an invalid or oversized tool list. Please check the MCP service.

upstream_error.zh-CN: 上游服务请求失败，请检查服务配置后重试。
upstream_error.en-US: The upstream request failed. Check the service configuration and try again.

mcp_url_invalid.zh-CN: MCP 服务地址无效，请填写有效的 HTTP(S) 地址。
mcp_url_invalid.en-US: The MCP service URL is invalid. Enter a valid HTTP(S) URL.

mcp_auth_config_invalid.zh-CN: 连接认证配置无效，请检查认证方式及 OAuth 配置。
mcp_auth_config_invalid.en-US: The connection authentication settings are invalid. Check the authentication method and OAuth configuration.

mcp_proxy_unavailable.zh-CN: 网络代理不可用，请检查代理配置。
mcp_proxy_unavailable.en-US: The network proxy is unavailable. Please check its configuration.

mcp_proxy_not_allowed.zh-CN: 个人连接不能使用系统代理。
mcp_proxy_not_allowed.en-US: Personal connections cannot use a system proxy.

mcp_test_denied.zh-CN: 请由凭证所有者测试独立认证连接，或由管理员测试集中认证连接。
mcp_test_denied.en-US: Independent connections must be tested by the credential owner; shared connections must be tested by an administrator.

expert_dependencies_invalid.zh-CN: 专家依赖配置无效，请检查关联格式及资源权限。
expert_dependencies_invalid.en-US: The expert dependencies are invalid. Check the reference format and resource permissions.

expert_dependency_duplicate.zh-CN: 专家关联资源重复，请移除重复项。
expert_dependency_duplicate.en-US: The expert contains duplicate resource references. Please remove them.

expert_dependency_unavailable.zh-CN: 专家关联资源不存在或不可用，请重新选择。
expert_dependency_unavailable.en-US: An expert dependency is missing or unavailable. Please select it again.

skill_package_required.zh-CN: 请上传技能 ZIP 包。
skill_package_required.en-US: Please upload a skill ZIP package.

skill_package_invalid.zh-CN: 技能包无效或超限，请检查 ZIP 内容、结构和大小。
skill_package_invalid.en-US: The skill package is invalid or too large. Check the ZIP contents, structure, and size.

skill_metadata_invalid.zh-CN: 技能元数据格式无效，请检查填写内容。
skill_metadata_invalid.en-US: The skill metadata is invalid. Please check the input.

storage_corrupted.zh-CN: 资源文件读取或校验失败，请重新上传或联系管理员。
storage_corrupted.en-US: The resource file could not be read or verified. Upload it again or contact your administrator.

model_key_required.zh-CN: 模型 API Key 不能为空。
model_key_required.en-US: A model API key is required.

model_config_invalid.zh-CN: 模型配置无效，请检查模型名称、协议、服务地址和能力配置。
model_config_invalid.en-US: The model configuration is invalid. Check the model name, protocol, service URL, and capabilities.

model_capability_invalid.zh-CN: 模型能力配置不受支持，请检查画质、比例或视频参数。
model_capability_invalid.en-US: The model capability settings are not supported. Check image quality, aspect ratios, or video parameters.

api_key_error.zh-CN: 调用密钥操作失败，请检查名称、权限和有效期后重试。
api_key_error.en-US: The API key operation failed. Check the name, scopes, and expiration, then try again.

sharing_invalid.zh-CN: 分享参数无效，请检查资源和接收用户或分组。
sharing_invalid.en-US: The sharing request is invalid. Check the resources and recipient users or groups.

sharing_recipient_invalid.zh-CN: 接收用户或分组不存在或已停用，请重新选择。
sharing_recipient_invalid.en-US: A recipient user or group is missing or disabled. Please select it again.

sharing_self_denied.zh-CN: 不能将资源分享给自己。
sharing_self_denied.en-US: You cannot share a resource with yourself.

tags_invalid.zh-CN: 标签无效或已删除，请重新选择。
tags_invalid.en-US: A tag is invalid or has been deleted. Please select it again.

feedback_invalid.zh-CN: 反馈内容或附件无效，请检查分类、评分、内容及图片限制。
feedback_invalid.en-US: The feedback or its attachments are invalid. Check the category, rating, content, and image limits.

feedback_in_progress.zh-CN: 反馈仍在处理中，请稍后重试。
feedback_in_progress.en-US: The feedback is still being processed. Please try again later.

feedback_failed.zh-CN: 反馈处理失败，请稍后重试。
feedback_failed.en-US: The feedback could not be processed. Please try again later.

idempotency_conflict.zh-CN: 幂等键已用于其他请求，请检查原请求结果。
idempotency_conflict.en-US: The idempotency key was used for a different request. Please check the original result.

reporting_disabled.zh-CN: 会话上报已关闭，请联系管理员。
reporting_disabled.en-US: Session reporting is disabled. Please contact your administrator.

payload_too_large.zh-CN: 请求内容超过大小限制，请缩减后重试。
payload_too_large.en-US: The request exceeds the size limit. Reduce it and try again.

stale_state_seq.zh-CN: 会话状态已更新，请同步后重试。
stale_state_seq.en-US: The session state has changed. Sync and try again.

cursor_mismatch.zh-CN: 会话上报位置不一致，请同步后重试。
cursor_mismatch.en-US: The session reporting cursor is out of sync. Sync and try again.
